229 passed, 23 skipped, no regressions. Here's a summary of the changes made:

**`src/click/_termui_impl.py`:**
- Added `show_speed: bool = False` parameter to `ProgressBar.__init__` and stored it as `self.show_speed`
- Added `format_speed()` method that returns `"X.XX/s"` (items/sec from `1.0 / time_per_iteration`) or `"?"` when no timing data is available yet
- Added `show_speed` branch in `format_progress_line()` — only shown when not finished (so the bar disappears on completion, matching `show_eta` behavior)

**`src/click/termui.py`:**
- Added `show_speed: bool = False` to both `@t.overload` signatures and the implementation of `progressbar()`
- Added `:param show_speed:` docstring entry
- Passes `show_speed=show_speed` through to the `ProgressBar` constructor

**`tests/test_termui.py`:**
- `test_progressbar_format_speed_no_data` — `"?"` returned before any timing data
- `test_progressbar_format_speed` (parametrized) — correct speed string for given `avg` values
- `test_progressbar_show_speed_off_by_default` — `/s` absent when option not set
- `test_progressbar_show_speed_in_progress_line` — speed appears in the formatted line when enabled
- `test_progressbar_show_speed_hidden_when_finished` — speed hidden after bar finishes
- `test_progressbar_show_speed_via_progressbar_function` — public `progressbar()` passes the flag through correctly
